lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular local maxima arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits, with larger centroids appearing more prominently in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a discernible grid-like anchor system across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal ridge feature is visible across the upper flank, defined by a distinct pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and shadow-induced low luminance on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density distribution of small-diameter, high-luminance points on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, showing a clear contrast in scale compared to the larger blobs on the lateral flank.
